entities.name: Kuthuman
entities.description: A Dominarian planeswalker and Grand Master of the Arena of Kush who ascended on the Night of Fire.

entities.name: Arena of Kush
entities.description: Arena in Estark in Kush, run by Kuthuman as Grand Master.

entities.name: Night of Fire
entities.description: The destruction of House Oor-tael in 4048 AR, after which Kuthuman ascended.

entities.name: Zarel
entities.description: Kuthuman's servant, made new Grand Master of the Arena.

entities.name: Kirlen
entities.description: Kuthuman's then-lover who discovered the spark-igniting spell.

entities.name: Cullinarn
entities.description: Master of House Oor-tael who once saved Kuthuman.

entities.name: House of Oor-tael
entities.description: House that refused Kuthuman's order and was destroyed.

entities.name: Garth One-Eye
entities.description: Son of the Master of Oor-tael who defeated Kuthuman.

entities.name: Norreen
entities.description: She helped Garth seal the gate.

entities.name: Festival of Estark
entities.description: Festival whose champion Kuthuman took away to kill.

events.summary: Kuthuman bribed four Houses to destroy Oor-tael, the Night of Fire, and used stolen mana to ignite his spark.
Kuthuman appointed Zarel as new Grand Master of the Arena.
events.quote: He appointed Zarel as the new Grand Master of the Arena

events.summary: Kuthuman secretly killed festival champions to weed out challengers.
events.quote: the true intention of Kuthuman was to find the strongest fighters and kill them secretly

events.summary: Garth One-Eye won the Festival and Kuthuman took him to his realm.
events.quote: When Garth won the Festival, Kuthuman transported both of them to the heart of his realm.

events.summary: Garth defeated Kuthuman by draining his core mana and took the spell.
events.quote: Garth defeated Kuthuman by draining him of his core mana.

events.summary: Garth sealed the gate against Kuthuman's return with Norreen's help.
events.quote: Garth was able to "seal the gate" with Norreen's help

relations.quote: He served as Grand Master of the Arena of Kush
under the suggestion of his servant Zarel

relations.note: tracked him down and defeated him
relations.quote: he was tracked down by Garth One-Eye , son of the Master of Oor-tael
